decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No demolition works shall commence until a detailed survey (including photographic records if necessary) of the listed walls has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Please note that the listed walls shall be retained, if any works are proposed to the walls a separate Listed Building application will be required.

Condition : 4 - No demolition of works shall commence until a scheme for the retention of material from the demolition of the western building and enclosing brick wall to the south has been submitted to and approved for use in the repair of the Peerless Pumps building. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the details.
description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING BUILDINGS AND SHEDS TO REAR OF 56-60  HIGH STREET
